name: win
summary: Windows checks in the externally configured Windows ARM VM (QEMU; tools/win-vm): MSVC x64 engine build + tests + golden renders compared with macOS hashes; plugin build + pluginval + REAPER smoke test. `package` builds the Windows installer (Inno Setup, unsigned for Release 1), checks it installs and uninstalls, and zips it with a README.txt (BlokDust-<version>-Windows.zip).
outputs: JSON summary; full logs in .cache/win-engine.log and .cache/win-plugin.log
